title: FolderStructure
description: How a project's folder tree is laid out relative to PROJECT_ROOT at build time (buildtime.yaml) and in distribution at runtime (runtime.yaml)

RelativeFolderPath.description: A folder path relative to PROJECT_ROOT, with no leading slash, trailing slash, or parent-directory traversal

RulesFolder.description: Folder containing the governance YAML documents (Rules.yaml, Principles.yaml, Definitions.yaml), relative to PROJECT_ROOT

SchemasFolder.description: Folder containing the JSON Schema contracts, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

ReferencesFolder.description: Folder containing runtime reference indexes bundled with the skill, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

BinFolder.description: Folder containing the bundled CLI executables (review-tool.mjs and review-tool-probe.mjs), relative to PROJECT_ROOT

ClientFolder.description: Inbound CLI entrypoints and argument handling at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

ControllerFolder.description: Application controllers at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

AdaptersFolder.description: Outbound adapters implementing domain interfaces and translating external API shapes via Zod codecs at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

DomainFolder.description: Domain contracts, domain interfaces, and pure domain logic at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

IntegrationTestFolder.description: Black-box integration tests at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

ClientsFolder.description: Generated external API clients and wire schemas at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT

HostReferencesFolder.description: Downloaded OpenAPI and GraphQL specifications used to generate external clients at build time, relative to PROJECT_ROOT
